nom: Pacifica Melt For You Moisturizing Oil Cleanser

avis.texte: The Pacifica Moisturizing Oil Cleanser smells wonderful and d cleans without drying my skin. I love the feel of it on my skin!
This is an absolutely wonderful pre cleanser, even better than Dermalogica and less than half the price. I'm a licensed esthetician and this is one of my biggest recommendations.
I use this occasionally when I want something more luxurious. I don't use a soap with it. But for someone who can't use anything ever due to intense allergies, it's a miracle.

Bought this one to try a drugstore alternative of an oil cleanser, and I was once again fooled into thinking something that calls itself an oil cleanser is an actual oil cleanser. This is a gel formula that contains a little oil in it. Bad marketing, decieving, and just a run of the mill facewash!

I've been using Pacifica for a long time now and this is one of my favorite cleansers. I expected it to be more like a traditional oil cleanser but it does foam up. I have oily skin so I love it even more when I get hormonal breakouts cuz it helps my skin calm down without feeling tight and it smells amazing!

avis.titre: It's a cleanser formulated with oils, not an oil cleanser.
avis.texte: I prefer washing my face with an oil cleanser and I decided to try this one when my peach and lily one ran out. It's strangly drying and feels mostly like any gel cleanser on the face, which is disappointing because I like oil cleansers for the texture and moisturizing nature of them. Smells good and gets the job done at least.
If I'm wearing light makeup, it cleanses my face well. For heavier makeup I have to wash twice. It's semi effective on waterproof mascara. It's gentle and doesn't irritate my skin

avis.titre: Sometimes just don't come off completely.
avis.texte: It doesn't feel greasy at all, yet it removes foundation and makeup really well. It also works great for cleaning foundation sponges and makeup brushes.

I have dry skin so I really love using an oil cleanser. Thankfully this cleanser completely removes makeup and cleanses in one step leaving my face fresh and hydrated. It rinses completely and doesn't irritate my skin. I use Retin-A so I need something gentle and effective that will leave my face clean but not stripped. I love the smell and texture of this product. I have tried SO many cleansers in the past and this one really works perfectly for me. Love, Love, Love!!

avis.titre: I am not sure about this product
avis.texte: I bought this and the Pacifica foam cleanser to use together. Well I'm unsure which one but either I had an allergic reaction or these two cleansers completely stripped my skin!!

avis.titre: Redownloaded this app to rant it's that bad
avis.texte: I have durable skin & i look like a tomato. Might as well spray body spray on your face. How do you advertise as makeup remover & then burn my eyes more than shampoo?

I wish so much that this worked, i really liked it the first days. Then i realised that it was breaking me out. Not only is it breaking me out i guess my skin doesnt like it at all at all, its hot to the touch. What sucks is the price point is nice and its soo good and getting every ounce of make up off espescailly eye makeup

As someone with dry skin, this is perfect for me. Ive been using miscellaneous makeup removers throughout my life and found myself breaking out - this is perfect. It actually gets all of my makeup off while moisturizing my skin. My only con is that it has a peachy scent and I'm not the biggest fan of peaches, but still the quality of this product is stellar.

This is another foaming cleanser. I keep hoping for a cleanser from Pacifica that doesn't lather but haven't found one yet. It does smell nice and the lather is creamier than most so if you like foaming cleansers you might like it.
This cleaner is amazing. Not only does it get my face clean of the daily grime. This is great at getting oils off my glasses. It smells like my Grandmas peach cobbler!
This is the best oil cleanser I have tried! I have used many oil or balm cleansers in the past but this is next level. It removes makeup extremely well and the texture and smell cannot be beat!

I love oil cleansers and I also love Pacifica products. The bottle is beautiful and the fragrance is amazing. I have sensitive skin snd use retin A from time to time. This product burned my face and it took over three days for it to heal. May be ok if you don't use any acids or peels and if you don't have sensitive skin.
I love this cleanser! You only need a tiny drop. It seems to clean my face so much better. It smells lovely, not like an over powering perfume smell.

One pump is all it takes to completely cover my entire face and neck with such a lush, creamy cleanser. I have never used a product like this before! It feels so soft and smooth and 💯 gets the job done! My new favorite Pacifica facial cleanser!
Love this moisturizing oil cleanser. Never dries my skin. Leaves it super clean and smooth! I recommend it!
Fantastic product Please make a perfume or body spray with the same scent!!!

Not gonna lie I wasnt sure this would be able to take my waterproof Dior mascara off and was I wrong! This takes makeup off better than anything else that I've used. seriously impressed Pacifica. I only have to wash my makeup off once with this magic. highly recommend plus it smells really good and it doesn't make me break out!!!

avis.titre: Fantastic, not drying and smells great
avis.texte: Very good product. I prefer a lighter oil based cleanser for evening cleansing. I was using the Neutrogena Light Cleansing Oil, but it was discontinued. Saw this was new here, and had a similar process of use. Glad I bought it because it's even better. It cleanses while not stripping my skin. And it smells just like a fresh peach, def a plus. Only thing is the package says to use 1-3 pumps, one is for sure enough as it lathers quite well.
This is great! It's really good for cleansing off sunscreen. Great for a double cleanse. I wish there was an unscented option though!

avis.titre: Love to Mellt my Makeup off!
avis.texte: I bought this product on the website and love how easy it is to clear the makeup off of my face. My face is moisturized and clean at the same time!
OK, not great, at removing makeup. Not good for eye makeup, caused burning sensation on my sensitive eyes. Do not recommend.

avis.titre: Melt For You Moisturizing Oil Cleanser
avis.texte: I love this cleanser! It doesn't make my skin feel dry after, and it is the best smelling cleanser I've ever used.
Gentle and foaming and removes stubborn makeup. Doesn't irritate my skin and smells like summer peaches

avis.titre: Neutral. Depends on the season or climate.
avis.texte: I have more oily skin in summer and lean to balanced/dry in winter. It dried out my balanced skin in winter. I think it's just fine for summer. But in low humidity environments I need alot more than this gives. Also, I had a hard time knowing how much was left. The package needs a side window to see how much is left. Other brands use clearer bottles to see how much is left.

avis.titre: Best cleanser I have found in a while
avis.texte: I have pretty sensitive skin and will break out easily, especially along my chest area and I started using this cleanser two months ago and have seen a huge change in my breakouts as well as my redness in my face. I would definitely recommend and buy again.

avis.titre: Best cleanser I have found in a while
avis.texte: I have pretty sensitive skin and will break out easily, especially along my chest area and I started using this cleanser two months ago and have seen a huge change in my breakouts as well as my redness in my face. I would definitely recommend and buy again.
I have combination skin, and this was extremely drying for me, even when starting with smoothing an oil over my skin. Stripped my moisture barrier and irritated my skin. Smells really good though.
This one was good on my skin ,no allergic reaction for my sensitive skin, I love it

avis.titre: Love it so much I use it as a body wash too.
avis.texte: I love this stuff so much I use it as a body wash too. My skin and my nose are insanely sensitive. Strong scents give me migraines and most cleansers and soaps dry me out so badly my skin flakes, cracks and bleeds. This stuff though is perfect. It's gentle, smells amazing without being strong, and removes my make up easily. So I started using it as a body wash as well because it's so soothing and now I'm even considering using it as my hand soap since my hands are still always cracked from actual hand soap...

Sad that this didn't work out for me. I love pacifica and I usually don't have any issues with their products. I had an allergic reaction immediately when I used this. It left my skin red and swollen. My pores did look a lot cleaner though.

avis.titre: Smells like heaven, feels like clouds
avis.texte: I bought this product from PAC about a month ago after eyeing it online for a while and I am so glad that I did. It cleans my face superbly and makes my skin feel so soft and look dewy and fresh. It also smells amazing! I think it's becoming one of my favorite all time PAC face washes - if not products. I have been a customer… forever…. so, I know my products! Thank you guys, for always improving, and, creating , great products!!!
I've tried oil cleansers and out of all, this is the one I like most. One pump and it takes all my makeup off with no issue
This oil cleanser takes EVERYTHING OFF!! I avoid the eye area so can't really say how it is with eye makeup, but all the face makeup is removed. So good, highly recommend!

Out of the oil cleansers I've used, this one is the nicest. It smells good and truly takes it all off for me. I use this and then the grapefruit bubble cleanser after and my face feels so clean after. Love love love

I personally love this cleanser! It's cleansing but not too drying. My eye makeup needs a little extra cleansing, but it's waterproof so that's expected. I've had no issues or bad reactions to this product. I love the scent (and I'm picky about scented products).
Unfortunately,I did not smell this in store before buying it. It was a little too strong for me. Only used it once, so not sure how well it actually works. Hoping I can return.

avis.titre: Best cleansing oil- moisturizing, rinses well and smells so
avis.texte: Finally found a cleanser that I absolutely love. Have been searching for a long time for an oil based cleanser that was moisturizing but cleansed and rinsed well and that smelled delicious. This has checked all the boxes and has become my favorite cleanser to use.

avis.titre: Not safe to use near the eye area
avis.texte: Not safe to use near the eye area. Causes severe burning to eyes with any contact resulting in severe pain, swelling, and redness that takes a day to recover from if handled appropriately. If not handled appropriately by immediately flushing with water for 15 to 20 minutes, then medical attention may be necessary. Does not even remove light makeup well.
This face wash smells so delicious…like peaches. It removes my makeup and sunblock so well. I love it and will definitely purchase again.

I've got oily skin. I use this now before my cleanser and it's a total winner. The smell is amazing! Smells like a peach, but like a juicy peach with fuzz on it. Next, it takes off makeup very well, including eye makeup better than a cleansing balm or eye makeup remover. Half a pump of this and then my usual cleanser and everything is gone. It's an 8 oz bottle so it's a good value for it's size.

This is seriously the best cleanser i have ever used. I do alot of makeup that uses body paint too. This product actually makes it easy to remove the makeup & bodypaint! But it is heavily scented. Its so strong it can give a headache. Otherwise its seriously the best! Also the heavy fragrance can cause reactions if you have a fragrance allergy.

I've always had super dry and sensitive skin so this face wash is a lifesaver. I can feel it cleaning my skin without leaving it flakey. Not to mention it smells wonderful and feels like a mini spa everytime I wash my face 🥰🍑
Natural moisturizing smoothing noncomedogenic oil, smells perfect, flowery
The Melt for You Moisturizing Oil Cleanser is my new favorite. It also has a great scent!

I didn't love the way it felt to begin with, but waking up with both eyes swollen shut was the last straw on this product. I have used quite a few Pacifica products, but will be returning this. Once my eyes aren't swollen shut.
This is the cleanser I have been missing since my favorite Rose Kombucha was discontinued. The lather is so creamy and it cleans my skin well without stripping. And the smell - delightful!!

I am incredibly picky with face wash as I have sensitive skin with light rosacea, but since using this as my makeup remover/daily cleansing wash my breakouts have been non existent to minimal. I also really appreciate that the peach smell isn't artificially overdone like a lot of peach products tend to be. Please don't discontinue this product, it's a hit for me!!

HORRIBLE. normally I can use Pacifica without any issues. I've loved everything I've ever tried from this brand and have multiple daily favorites. But I tried this and a few minutes after using it, I started experiencing multiple symptoms. My face got red, hot and stinging extremely bad. My heart rate raced. I used my at home oxygen and heart rate meter and both were abnormal. It took hours for it to go back to normal and I almost needed medical attention. I don't recommend this at all.
Saves my from having to wash my face 3-4 times to get all of the makeup off.

avis.titre: Great oil cleanser for double cleansing!
avis.texte: I have super reactive, acne prone skin. This cleanser is a great addition to my skincare routine to take off makeup and gunk from the day! No issues with breakouts or anything.

I have very sensitive skin and breakout easily. This face wash has caused NO breakouts! Also, what I'm really loving is my face feels clean and almost scrubbed. Let me be clear, this isn't a scrub. But you know how some faces washes don't really feel like they are doing anything... this one does. I'm totally hooked.

avis.titre: i wish i could use it.
avis.texte: i have sensitive skin and acne prone skin but this product gave me a allergic reaction almost immediately.

This product did an exceptional job removing makeup and cleansing the skin. My skin is hormonal and hyper sensitive and this did not irritate, dry or stress my skin. It feels super refreshing and calming and thoroughly removed my makeup including mascara and liquid lipstick. I've used it as both a makeup remover and a face wash and loved it either way. I just repurchased it so I don't run out! 10/10

I used to have to double cleanse but this cleanser takes care of it all without having to do it twice. It smells like yummy peaches and makes my skin feel hydrated, also removes my makeup great too. I highly recommend!

Omg, this oil cleanser is ahhhhmazing. Love that it cleases and leaves face feeling super smooth and clean and the peach scent is perfect. Not too strong. Removes makeup very well. Highly recommend. Also I have oily skin and it does wonders.
Luxury in a bottle! It smells so good & feels so divine. I can't wait to wash my face!!

I cannot say enough about this cleanser. It is like a thick luxurious oil that foams. It smells light and amazing. I need an entire line that smells this peachy and delicious. It cleans impeccably. No need for double washing. My skin is so clean yet moisturized after using. I have dry skin but I can see this being amazing for any skin type. I feel like I need to stock up before it sells out because I'm obsessed.
